{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
-- explode order lines to models (handling bundles)
lines AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, ol.qty AS line_qty, l.sku_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND s.store_name = 'Walmart-CA-04'
    AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
-- expand bundles into item skus
sku_expand AS (
  SELECT order_id, order_date, line_qty, sku_id AS item_sku_id
  FROM lines
  WHERE sku_id NOT IN (SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE is_bundle)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT le.order_id, le.order_date, le.line_qty * bi.qty, bi.item_sku_id
  FROM lines le
  JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = le.sku_id
  WHERE le.sku_id IN (SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE is_bundle)
),
-- map item skus to models
model_expand AS (
  SELECT se.order_id, se.order_date, se.line_qty * sm.qty AS model_qty, sm.model_id
  FROM sku_expand se
  JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = se.item_sku_id
),
-- explode models to components recursively with validity on order date
comp_expand AS (
  SELECT me.order_id, me.order_date, me.model_qty * mb.qty AS comp_qty, mb.component_id
  FROM model_expand me
  JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = me.model_id
    AND mb.valid_from <= me.order_date AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR me.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ce.order_id, ce.order_date, ce.comp_qty * cb.qty, cb.child_component_id
  FROM comp_expand ce
  JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = ce.component_id
    AND cb.valid_from <= ce.order_date AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR ce.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT SUM(ce.comp_qty) AS total_units
FROM comp_expand ce
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = ce.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'BRA-882-WAL-01433'
  AND c.is_assembly = false;"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
-- explode order lines to models, handling bundles
line_model AS (
  SELECT ol.order_id, o.order_date, ol.qty AS line_qty, sm.model_id, sm.qty AS model_qty
  FROM order_line ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
  JOIN store s ON s.store_id = l.store_id
  JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = l.sku_id
  JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = sk.sku_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND s.store_name = 'Shopify-DE-21'
    AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND sk.is_bundle = false
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ol.order_id, o.order_date, ol.qty AS line_qty, sm.model_id, bi.qty * sm.qty AS model_qty
  FROM order_line ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
  JOIN store s ON s.store_id = l.store_id
  JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = l.sku_id
  JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = sk.sku_id
  JOIN sales_sku item ON item.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
  JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = item.sku_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND s.store_name = 'Shopify-DE-21'
    AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND sk.is_bundle = true
),
-- explode models to components recursively
comp_path AS (
  SELECT lm.order_id, lm.order_date, lm.line_qty * lm.model_qty AS qty, mb.component_id, mb.qty AS comp_qty
  FROM line_model lm
  JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = lm.model_id
    AND mb.valid_from <= lm.order_date AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR lm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cp.order_id, cp.order_date, cp.qty, cb.child_component_id, cp.comp_qty * cb.qty
  FROM comp_path cp
  JOIN component c ON c.component_id = cp.component_id AND c.is_assembly = true
  JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = cp.component_id
    AND cb.valid_from <= cp.order_date AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cp.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT SUM(cp.qty * cp.comp_qty) AS total_units
FROM comp_path cp
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = cp.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'CAB-563-BLK-01890' AND c.is_assembly = false"}
